title: Orchestrator-Workers Pipeline by Hand
learning_objectives: Decompose a task into typed subtasks with a planner
Route subtasks to specialised workers in dependency order
Use an evaluator to request revisions within a round limit
hints: Topological order of subtasks by `deps` using a heap of ready ids (AG-13).
Call `workers[s['type']](s['input'], {d: outputs[d] for d in s['deps']})` inside try/except.
On a worker error, log it, mark the round failed and skip the evaluator; set `feedback` accordingly.

failure_feedback.advice: Log the plan, each executed subtask and the evaluator decision with the exact formats.
Execute subtasks in dependency order (smallest ready id first).
Pass the evaluator's feedback to the planner in the next round.
Catch worker exceptions, log them and skip evaluation for that round.
